title: Dance work, advertising and parading jobs
summary: Most of the work was dance jobs; he let the band do the advertising and also played parades and advertising wagons.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Some guys just have that. I guess it's an instinct or something. Yeah. Anyway, what kind of jobs did y'all play at that band? Did you play steady dance work?
Yeah, the biggest majority of it was all dance work.
No, I didn't advertise at all. I let the band advertise. Well, that's what I mean.
Did you play advertising jobs on trucks or wagons or? Oh, yes.
I got all kinds. I would parade on the... You paraded, huh? Oh, yes. I paraded. I played all kinds of jobs. So you got around.
